about_the_game: This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64-Bit (Latest Update).
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or Intel Core i5 6600k
  • Memory: DDR4 Dual Channel 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 570 or Nvidia GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance when set to ""Low"" preset: 1280x720 @ 60 FPS SSD Recommended
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64-Bit (Latest Update).
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X or Intel Core i7 6700
  • Memory: Dual Channel 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5600 XT or Nvidia GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance when set to ""Medium"" preset: 1920x1080 @ 60 FPS SSD Required
